items.text: ghoztty +close on Windows fails instead of claiming success over an unanswered close confirmation, and +close --force closes with no confirmation and no undo.
The published 1.54.16 build no longer hitches each time a pane folds at 4K; a rarer one-frame stall in 2 of 5 drags is now filed as T2943.
The rare 4K fold-glide slow frame is the heaviest frame meeting a window-manager delay; its fix moves to T2942.
A folding card's strip label no longer re-cuts its window shape every frame at 4K; the shape now lives in its pixels.
A card that only slides at 4K no longer flickers a pixel in size each frame, and glass panes stop paying for fresh memory every glide tick.
At 4K the desk behind a fold glide is now redrawn across several cores, so the heaviest glide frames no longer reach 12 ms.
At 4K the strip face over a folding card is now painted across several cores, so the heaviest glide frames reach 10 ms a third as often.
At 4K a narrow viewer beside a fold glide no longer re-shapes its hidden contents card every frame, so the heaviest glide frame is now about 10 ms.
